A '''cruiser''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] combat vessel operated by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. The ''[[Desaclates]]'' was a cruiser operated by the Exocron Airfleet that fell under attack from [[Corsairs]] from the [[western canyons]].
